_about: The anticipation of a press that has to wait (docs/animation/press-ack.md). Encounter sends a cue press_ack, text queued, on a player's press tick when the press can't start yet (actor the presser, source its button cell: x a light, y a heavy, b a signature; n the tick it is due to start when the wait is a cooldown, else -1; amount the ticks to it). AnimFighter.on_press_ack plays the cell's pose (wave ack1, prefix ak: a light's short lean in, a heavy's weight moving forward and a shoulder wound, a signature's sink) mixed over the idle stance at `w` (0 to 1) and ramped in over enter_ticks (6: the snappy profile solves on twos, so a 3-tick ramp showed as one jump of 0.72). It is held until the exchange starts (the wind-up cue, a blow taken, the fighter leaving his stand, an approach) or hold ends (the wait, else max_ticks), and let go over exit_ticks, so the real wind-up takes over with nothing popping: the pose is a part weight and shallower than the held blows' bodies. A wait under min_wait ticks shows nothing (the exchange starts before it could read). fighters: a roster id's own pose for a cell. Under reduced motion the weight is scaled by 0.6. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. First values, Animation's.
